about: Hand-maintained. Station order, end-to-end minutes, typical minutes between trains and transfer walks for the lines that are running. scripts/fetch-rail.ts adds station positions from OpenStreetMap and writes data/rail.json. Figures are secondary sources checked on 2026-10-18; replace them with operator data when available.
entryNote: Assumption, not measured: minutes to get through security and tap in, at the first station and again at each transfer (fares aren't integrated, so you tap out and in). Peak-hour queues can be much longer.

sources: Round trip 91 min in 2024, per LRMC, quoted by expressway.ph/transit/lrt1-line-guide
Peak 3-4 min, off-peak about 5 min: mapa-metro.com (unofficial)
About 40 min Antipolo to Recto, 17.6 km: expressway.ph/transit/lrt2-line-guide
Every 12-14 min in 2026 because of limited fleet availability: mapa-metro.com (unofficial)
About 30 min North Avenue to Taft Avenue: expressway.ph/transit/mrt-line-guide; 32 min in a 2026 line guide
Every 3.5 min at peak: travel guide (unofficial)

transfers.source: Through Gateway Mall, 10-15 min: 3d-universal.com transfer guide (unofficial)
